<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 5.07 Submission of Matters to a Vote of Shareholders</b></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company&#8217;s annual meeting of shareholders was held on April 29, 2026.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Proposal 1.</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The stockholders elected to the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors for a term of three years were Jeffery C. Baker, Patrick G. Hagan, and Amy F. Rieck. Directors whose term of office continued after the annual meeting consist of Douglas W. Beals, Michelle R. Cassabaum, Lisa M. Eslinger, Everett S. Miles, John P. Nelson, John L. Pierschbacher, Kevin L. Swartz and Scot A. Trost.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Proposal 2.</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The stockholders approved, on an advisory basis, the compensation of the Company&#8217;s named executives, as disclosed in the Compensation Discussion and Analysis, the compensation tables and related narrative disclosure in the Company&#8217;s proxy statement for the annual meeting.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Proposal 3.</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The stockholders also ratified the appointment of Forvis Mazars, LLP as the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting firm for 2026.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">There were 8,857,220 shares of common stock entitled to vote at the annual meeting. The final voting results of each proposal are set forth below.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
